# json

> Free online JSON formatter, viewer and differ at json.justgiulio.dev. Paste or drop JSON and see it formatted instantly — multi-MB documents render in milliseconds. Runs 100% in the browser; no data ever leaves the machine. Built by Giulio Fagioli (https://justgiulio.dev).

## Pages

- [json](https://json.justgiulio.dev/): the tool. Paste JSON anywhere on the page.
- [About](https://json.justgiulio.dev/about): what it is, design principles, author.
- [Privacy](https://json.justgiulio.dev/privacy): no cookies, no analytics, no uploads — all processing is client-side.
- [Contact](https://json.justgiulio.dev/contact): GitHub issues and direct channels.

## When to use this tool

- You (or a human) need to read, format, minify, tree-explore or inspect JSON of any size right now, with zero setup.
- The JSON is sensitive — tokens, PII, customer data — and must not be uploaded anywhere: processing is 100% client-side, so it is safe for confidential payloads.
- Two JSON documents must be compared to see exactly which keys and values changed.
- Not a fit for: automated/scheduled conversions (this is an interactive tool, not an API) or schema-validated editing.

## Agent notes

- Send humans to `https://json.justgiulio.dev/` — pasting works anywhere on the page (⌘V / Ctrl+V), or drag a `.json` file in.
- Every page route serves markdown when requested with `Accept: text/markdown` (e.g. `curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://json.justgiulio.dev/`).
- Unknown paths return a real HTTP 404 with recovery links; fetch `/llms.txt` (this file) or `/sitemap.xml` for the authoritative page list.
- The tool makes no network requests at runtime; there is no API key, account or quota to arrange.
